run_vector_store_search: run vector store search before LLM call and append relevant context to messages
test_extract_query: test extracting the query string from the last user message in a conversation
refactor_append_context: refactor appending vector store search results as context into chat messages
review_add_search_results: review adding vector store search results to the LLM response provider_specific_fields
summarize_streaming_hook: summarize adding search results to the final streaming chunk of an LLM response
